instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched ZBrush graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run ZScript files, Python, macros, or other helper scripts/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only ZBrush native GUI tools, menus, brushes, and built-in export commands. ArrayMesh Circular Array (12 columns around a colonnade) The opened `scene.obj` contains a ZBrush Tool whose first (and only) SubTool, named Column, is an axis-aligned cuboid of size 0.2 x 2.0 x 0.2 BU (width x height x depth) centred at world position (-2, 1, 0). The column therefore extends x in [-2.1, -1.9], y in [0, 2], z in [-0.1, 0.1]. The mesh has 8 vertices and 6 quad faces, a single default polygroup, no UVs, and no polypaint. Using the opened OBJ in ZBrush, use ArrayMesh to create a circular array of 12 copies of the column, equally spaced 30 degrees apart around the world Y axis, so that each copy's centroid lies on a circle of radius 2.0 BU in the XZ plane at height y = 1. Bake the array into real geometry, produce 12 individual SubTools named Col_01 through Col_12, and export the result as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.obj`. The exported `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.obj` must satisfy: - Exactly 12 SubTools, named Col_01 through Col_12. - Each SubTool has exactly 8 vertices and 6 quad faces. - Each SubTool's centroid projected onto the XZ plane lies on a circle of radius 2.0 BU within 0.02 BU. - Each SubTool's Y extent is [0, 2] within 0.01 BU. - Consecutive columns' centroid angles, sorted around the Y axis, differ by 30 degrees within 0.5 degree.

command:
import ctypes, time
user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
EnumWindowsProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
EnumChildProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
def close_error():
    wins = []
    def wcb(hwnd, lparam):
        buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(512)
        user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, buf, 512)
        if 'ZHomePage.exe' in buf.value and 'System Error' in buf.value:
            wins.append(hwnd)
        return True
    user32.EnumWindows(EnumWindowsProc(wcb), 0)
    for hwnd in wins:
        buttons = []
        def ccb(ch, lparam):
            text = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            cls = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            user32.GetWindowTextW(ch, text, 128)
            user32.GetClassNameW(ch, cls, 128)
            if text.value == 'OK' or cls.value == 'Button':
                buttons.append(ch)
            return True
        user32.EnumChildWindows(hwnd, EnumChildProc(ccb), 0)
        for ch in buttons:
            user32.SendMessageW(ch, 0x00F5, 0, 0)
time.sleep(95)
for _ in range(4):
    close_error()
    time.sleep(2)
